newsitem.title: USA: Whitman to spin off Hussmann, Midas.
newsitem.headline: Whitman to spin off Hussmann, Midas.

text.p: Whitman Corp said Monday its board of directors approved a plan to spin off to shareholders Hussmann Corp, which makes refrigeration systems for the food industry, and Midas International, a franchised automotive service operation.
Whitman, which will keep its Pepsi-Cola General Bottlers operation, said its board also authorized the repurchase of an additional five million shares of common stock.

Whitman said the plan to spin off Hussmann and Midas is subject to receipt of a ruling by the Internal Revenue Service that the transactions would be non-taxable to the company and its shareholders, as well as market conditions at the time.

The company said it is likely to take some special charges later this year, although it has yet to determine the size or timing. The charges will be to facilitate the spin-offs and position the companies for future growth, it added.

"We believe that as independent publicly traded companies, our businesses will realize a number of benefits," Bruce Chelberg, Whitman chairman and chief executive, said in a statement. "They'll be better able to attract and retain key management personnel, achieve further improvements in productivity and efficiency, realize new business opportunities, and win new customers for their products and services."
After the planned spinoffs, Whitman will focus on the beverage business, which currently accounts for half of its sale and more than half of its operating income.
"We believe this plan is in the best long-term interests of our shareholders, and we hope to bring it to a successful conclusion within the next six to nine months," Chelberg said.

Regarding the stock repurchase, Whitman said the shares will be available for general corporate purposes, including use in its employee benefit and long-term incentive programs. The repurchase of these shares will be made from time to time through open market and privately negotiated transactions.
The company has repurchased about 9.5 million share in the past four years out of a total of 10.5 milion shares that have been previously authorized for repurchase.
